subject: Draft MAP: InfraEdge evaluation scaffold + 50-day close proposal
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Eva Morales <eva@infraedge.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP: InfraEdge evaluation scaffold + 50-day close proposal

Hi Eva —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. I promised to put a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) and evaluation scaffold in a co-editable doc so your team can adjust timing and owners.

What I attached/linked here:
- redwood_map_template_v1.gdoc (editable MAP scaffold with sections: goals, success criteria, test prompts/evals, integration checklist, security gating, procurement milestones)
- a short procurement timeline template (infraedge_procurement_timeline.xlsx) you can copy into your tracker

Suggested high-level timeline (we can compress/expand):
1) Week 0–1: Kickoff, stakeholder alignment, access requests
2) Week 2–4: PoC/eval (integration + sample prompt set, quality validation)
3) Week 5–6: Performance tuning, cost forecast, security signoffs
4) Day 50: Targeted close (contract sign + reserved capacity onboarding)

Ask: please review the MAP doc and move any owners/dates that don’t match your internal calendar. If you want we can run a 30–45 min workshop next week to lock owners and acceptance criteria.

Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcdExample-redwood-map-v1

If you prefer I can send a condensed one-page SLA/acceptance matrix for your legal team.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: redwood_map_template_v1.gdoc (Google Doc stub)
Attachment: infraedge_procurement_timeline.xlsx (Excel stub)

From: Eva Morales <eva@infraedge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Contracts <contracts@infraedge.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: InfraEdge evaluation scaffold + 50-day close proposal

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the scaffold. I shared the doc with our ML infra lead and procurement. A few notes from our side after a quick pass:

- Can we move the integration checklist earlier (Week 1) so our infra team can start access + firewall rules while the PoC team builds sample prompts? That helps reduce end-to-end latency on the PoC.
- Procurement would like a clear PO milestone (we use a 14-day internal approval window once legal signs off). I attached our procurement timeline (internal) for reference.
- Security wants to run the InfraEdge_Security_Requirements.pdf against your SLA/security matrix. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide an SOC 2 + KMS architecture diagram during the PoC?

Also: our business sponsor (Ana R.) will only be available for decision meetings after Apr 4, so if we aim for a Day-50 close we’ll need those calendar constraints reflected in the MAP.

I’ll ask Contracts to review the one-pager SLA if you send it.

Best,
Eva Morales
Director of Product, InfraEdge
eva@infraedge.com

Attachment: InfraEdge_Security_Requirements.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Eva Morales <eva@infraedge.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: InfraEdge evaluation scaffold + 50-day close proposal

Thanks Eva — great context, and good call on moving the integration checklist earlier. I updated the MAP doc (see link below) with these changes:
- Integration checklist moved into Week 0–1 with explicit network and access owners (Jonas added firewall/infra tasks)
- PO milestone added with an estimated 14-day procurement approval window (we’ll set an internal reminder on Day 36 to start final PO push)
- Added a security deliverables row: SOC 2 report (Q3 2026 + current status), KMS/HSM integration notes, and a placeholder for the architecture diagram.

Regarding the SOC 2/KMS diagram — yes, we can provide the SOC 2 summary and a KMS architecture diagram during the PoC; I put "redwood_security_pkg_v1" in the attachments line as a stub and will follow up with the actual files via your security mailbox.

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
- Confirm owners in the MAP by EOD Thu Mar 25
- 30–45 min scoping workshop week of Mar 29 (we have availability Tue/Wed afternoons PT)
- If Ana is only free after Apr 4, we can set an executive decision checkpoint on Apr 7 and aim for contract signature by Apr 10–12 (which would move us slightly past Day 50 from kickoff; I annotated the MAP with both a strict 50-day and a pragmatic 60-day path)

Updated doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcdExample-redwood-map-v1 (edited)

Let me know which workshop slot works and I’ll send a calendar invite + pre-read (one-pager acceptance matrix).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_map_template_v1.gdoc (updated)
Attachment: redwood_security_pkg_v1 (stub)

From: Contracts <contracts@infraedge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Eva Morales <eva@infraedge.com>
Cc: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@infraedge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Draft MAP: InfraEdge evaluation scaffold + 50-day close proposal

Hi Marissa —

We reviewed the one-pager and the MAP scaffold. A few comments from legal that will affect the timeline:

1) We need a short addendum for data residency and audit access (InfraEdge operates in multiple regions). Please provide standard addendum language and an initial draft of the logging/audit evidence pack.
2) The security deliverables look fine but we need a firm date for SOC 2 evidence or an attestation letter.
3) Our procurement team will expect a 7–10 business day review window after redlines are received. That shifts your Day-50 target slightly depending on when we receive the redline set.

We attached the security checklist we run with vendors and highlighted a couple of fields we expect filled before contract execution. Please upload your SOC 2/architecture artifacts to the shared doc or SFTP and notify us when available.

Thanks — I copied our sponsor (Ana) to keep scheduling aligned.

Contracts Team
InfraEdge
contracts@infraedge.com

Attachment: InfraEdge_Security_Requirements.pdf (annotated - stub)
